s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of bloody diarrhea in a patient with significant weight loss and abdominal tenderness
salient_findings: Bloody diarrhea occurring up to seven times a day
Bilateral lower abdominal tenderness
Mild thickening of the wall of the right colon on ultrasound
Diffuse granular and friable mucosa on sigmoidoscopy
Moderately active colitis with cryptitis and crypt abscesses on biopsy
key_facts: Patient is a 34-year-old Palestinian prisoner
Patient is on day 33 of an organized hunger strike
Patient has a one-week history of bloody diarrhea
Patient's BMI reduced from 22.9 kg/m² to 19.4 kg/m²
Patient is pale
Routine laboratory tests are normal
Stool cultures are negative
Clostridium difficile toxin is not present
Ultrasound shows mild thickening of the wall of the right colon
Abdominal CT is normal
Sigmoidoscopy shows continuous diffuse granular and friable mucosa to the ascending colon
Biopsy findings show moderately active colitis with cryptitis and crypt abscesses
